name: Fast Dynamic Channel Breakout (18D + Macro Trend) (one-bar channel hold)
hypothesis_description: Only take the original 18-day upper-channel breakout if the next closed bar also closes above the then-current upper band and macro EMA100; test whether one-bar confirmation filters false breakouts.
diff_summary: Replace immediate crossover entry with prior-bar crossover plus current close above upper_band; leave exit and strategy parameters unchanged.
code:
class FastDynamicChannelBreakout(NoraStrategy):
    timeframe = '24h'
    sma_period = 18
    std_period = 18
    std_nbdev = 1.5
    macro_period = 100
    stop_loss_pct = 2.5
    risk_per_trade_pct = 4.0

    def on_bar(self):
        sma_val = sma(close, self.sma_period)
        std_val = stddev(close, self.std_period, self.std_nbdev)
        upper_band = sma_val + std_val
        macro = ema(close, self.macro_period)

        exit_sig = close < sma_val
        breakout_prev = self.op.previous(crossover(close, upper_band), 1)
        enter_sig = breakout_prev & (close > upper_band) & (close > macro)

        self.close(exit_sig)
        self.buy(enter_sig)
